expected.subject: dev.product_feedback/citation-deltas-2026-09-07
expected.value: Agent-customer finding from citation batch 3: scoped computation is a verified scalability improvement even when aggregate latency is dominated by broader stages and host variation. A first timing pair suggested faster acceptance, but reversing run order did not reproduce a clear end-to-end win. Keep scope counters and cold parity alongside latency, and do not attribute unchanged submit timing variation to citation maintenance. Retain raw alternatives when a policy suppresses derived rows, otherwise removing a stronger conflict cannot restore a weaker one without reconstruction. Warm owner/group delta work scales with affected groups; bootstrap, large shared groups and cache capacity remain real costs. Next target is reusing exact prepared evaluation in submission. This manager assessment is sourced in the committed implementation and local measurement report, not a claim of deployed improvement.
